originalDsl:
@diagram architecture
layout [direction: DOWN]
User service as "User"
UploadForm service as "File Upload Form"
UploadAPI service as "Upload Service"
VirusScanner service as "Virus Scanner Service"
StorageBucket database as "Object Storage"
NotifyService service as "Notification Service"

edge_1 = User -> UploadForm as "selects file and submits"
edge_2 = UploadForm -> UploadAPI as "send file"
edge_3 = UploadAPI -> VirusScanner as "scan for malware"
edge_4 = VirusScanner -> UploadAPI as "scan passed"
edge_5 = UploadAPI -> StorageBucket as "store file"
edge_6 = UploadAPI -> NotifyService as "send upload complete notice"

injectedDefects.description: removed closing quote on label "Object Storage"
